eventName: Palm seeds were planted across a 3-acre agricultural land
eventDescription:
Today, palm seeds were planted across a 3-acre agricultural land near Mamandur.
This land was purchased jointly by three friends. Unfortunately, despite drilling two borewells, they could not find water, making agricultural activities impossible.
However, with the noble thought that "No other farmer should face the same situation that we have experienced," they decided to turn this land into an initiative for protecting and improving groundwater resources.
As part of this effort, palm seeds were planted throughout the entire 3-acre land, maintaining a spacing of one seed for every 10 feet.
